rules: A hart in Machine mode may read the scounteren CSR at address 0x106.
A hart in Supervisor mode may read the scounteren CSR at address 0x106.
A hart in Machine mode may write to the scounteren CSR at address 0x106.
A hart in Supervisor mode may write to the scounteren CSR at address 0x106.
An attempt to read the scounteren CSR at address 0x106 by a hart in User mode shall raise an illegal-instruction exception.
An attempt to write to the scounteren CSR at address 0x106 by a hart in User mode shall raise an illegal-instruction exception.
A read from the scounteren CSR at address 0x106 shall have no side effects.
